```{r}
klaeger_ic50s <- syn("syn51288931") |>

kinomescan_kd_fits <- syn("syn69680641") |>
  read_csv()

  read_csv()

kinomescan_kinase_info <- syn("syn51286743") |>

```


```{r}
# Pearson R on log10 scale and n of the complete pairs that contribute to it
cor_label_data <- function(x, y) {
  x <- log10(x)
  y <- log10(y)
  complete <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  tibble(
    r = cor(x[complete], y[complete], method = "pearson"),
    n = sum(complete)
  )
}
```

```{r}
kinomescan_kd_fits_comp <-kinomescan_kd_fits |>
  filter(
    dataset == "original_repeat_replaced",
    !exclude_target,
    rhat < 1.01,
    classification != "discordant"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id, hmsl_id, name, Symbol = `Entrez Gene Symbol`,
    kd = pmin(kd, 10000),
    classification
  ) |>
  # aggregate to kinase level by taking the most potent kd per kinase
  group_by(lspci_id, Symbol) |>
  slice_min(kd, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

klaeger_ic50_comp <- klaeger_ic50s |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id, Symbol = Name,
    IC50 = pmin(IC50, 10000)
  ) |>
  power_inner_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("lspci_id", "Symbol"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "info",
      unmatched_keys_right = "info",
      duplicate_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

p <- klaeger_ic50_comp |>
  ggplot(
    # aes(value, pseudo_ic50, color = classification, shape = pseudo_ic50_relation)
    aes(IC50, kd)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 16,
    size = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("  R = ", signif(r, 2), "\n  n = ", n)
    ),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    data = \(x) cor_label_data(x$IC50, x$kd),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Kd Klaeger",
    y = "Kd Kinomescan"
  )
ggsave(
  "plots/klaeger_kd_vs_kinomescan_kd.pdf", p,
  width = 3, height = 3
)


```

Make venn diagram of overlap assayed compounds that we have information for
between Klaeger and Kinomescan

```{r}
library(ggvenn)
p <- bind_rows(
    klaeger = klaeger_ic50s |>
        select(lspci_id),
    kinomescan = kinomescan_pseudo_ic50s |>
        select(lspci_id),
    .id = "source"
) |>
    distinct() |>
    split(.$source) |>
    map("lspci_id") |>
    ggvenn(auto_scale = TRUE)
p
```

## Saifudeen

Saifudeen Kds were fit with the same Bayesian model as the Kinomescan data
(`fit_kd_gujral.py`). `kd_log` is the natural log of the Kd in M.

```{r}
saifudeen_cdk_map <- c(
  "CDK4+CCND1" = "CDK4-cyclinD1",
  "CDK4+CCND3" = "CDK4-cyclinD3"
)

saifudeen_compound_map <- saifudeen_kd_raw |>
  distinct(lspci_id, name_saifudeen = compound_id) |>
  power_inner_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp |>
      distinct(lspci_id, hmsl_id, name),
    by = "lspci_id",
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "info",
      duplicate_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

write_csv(
  saifudeen_compound_map,
  "data/saifudeen_compound_mapping.csv"
)

saifudeen_kd_comp <- saifudeen_kd_raw |>
  filter(
    status == "ok",
    kd_log_r_hat < 1.01
  ) |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id,
    Symbol = target |> recode(!!!saifudeen_cdk_map),
    saifudeen_kd = pmin(exp(kd_log_mean) * 1e9, 10000)
  )

saifudeen_vs_kinomescan <- saifudeen_kd_comp |>
  power_inner_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("lspci_id", "Symbol"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "info",
      unmatched_keys_right = "info",
      duplicate_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

saifudeen_kd_comp |>
  distinct(Symbol) |>
  arrange(Symbol) |>
  anti_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("Symbol")
  ) |>
  View()
```


```{r}
p <- saifudeen_vs_kinomescan |>
  ggplot(
    aes(saifudeen_kd, kd)
  ) +

  ) +

    ),

    x = "Kd Saifudeen",

  )

ggsave(
  "plots/saifudeen_kd_vs_kinomescan_kd.pdf", p,
  width = 3, height = 3
)
```

## Classical (frequentist) Kd fits vs Chembl

Classical fits often fail: they return NA, zero or Inf, or extrapolate far
outside the tested range. Missing, non-finite and non-positive estimates count as
failed fits. The remaining estimates are clamped to the Chembl range
(0.01–10,000 nM).

```{r}
classical_kd_long <- classical_fit_kd |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    `compound | kinase`, delim = " | ", names = c("compound", "kinase")
  ) |>
  rename(chembl_kd = `ChEMBL Kd`) |>
  pivot_longer(
    -c(compound, kinase, chembl_kd),
    names_to = "method", values_to = "fit_kd"
  ) |>
  filter(
    !method %in% c("MCMC", "MAP")
  ) |>
  # dr4pl failed for every pair
  group_by(method) |>
  filter(any(!is.na(fit_kd))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    method = str_replace(method, coll(" parameter"), "p") |>
      str_replace(coll("(noisy)"), "(het)"),
    package = str_extract(method, "^\\S+"),
    fit_ok = is.finite(fit_kd) & fit_kd > 0,
    fit_kd = if_else(fit_ok, pmin(pmax(fit_kd, 0.01), 10000), NA_real_)
  )

classical_common_pairs <- classical_kd_long |>
  group_by(compound, kinase) |>
  filter(all(fit_ok)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  distinct(compound, kinase)

classical_kd_metrics <- function(d) {
  d |>
    filter(fit_ok) |>
    mutate(
      x = log10(chembl_kd),
      y = log10(fit_kd)
    ) |>
    group_by(package, method) |>
    summarise(
      n_pairs = n(),
      pearson_r = cor(x, y),
      spearman_rho = cor(x, y, method = "spearman"),
      # # Pearson on pairs with a quantitative (non-capped) Chembl Kd
      # pearson_r_chembl_below_cap = cor(x[chembl_kd < 10000], y[chembl_kd < 10000]),
      # median_abs_log10_error = median(abs(y - x)),
      # within_10_fold = mean(abs(y - x) <= 1),
      # # Agreement of binder calls (Kd < 10,000 nM)
      # binder_balanced_accuracy = (
      #   mean(fit_kd[chembl_kd < 10000] < 10000) +
      #     mean(fit_kd[chembl_kd >= 10000] >= 10000)
      # ) / 2,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

classical_fit_summary <- bind_rows(
  all_fitted = classical_kd_long |>
    group_by(package, method) |>
    summarise(failure_rate = mean(!fit_ok), .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(classical_kd_metrics(classical_kd_long), by = c("package", "method")),
  common_pairs = classical_kd_long |>
    semi_join(classical_common_pairs, by = c("compound", "kinase")) |>
    classical_kd_metrics(),
  .id = "pair_subset"
) |>
  arrange(pair_subset, desc(pearson_r))

write_csv(classical_fit_summary, "classification/classical_fit_vs_chembl_summary.csv")
classical_fit_summary
```

```{r}
p <- classical_kd_long |>
  filter(fit_ok) |>
  ggplot(aes(chembl_kd, fit_kd)) +
  ggrastr::rasterise(
    geom_point(
      alpha = 0.2,
      shape = 16,
      size = 0.5
    ), dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
  ) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("  R = ", signif(pearson_r, 2), "\n  n = ", n_pairs)
    ),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    size = 3,
    data = classical_fit_summary |>
      filter(pair_subset == "all_fitted"),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  facet_wrap(~method, ncol = 3) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Kd Chembl",
    y = "Kd fit"
  ) +
  theme(strip.clip = "off")

p

ggsave(
  "plots/classical_fit_kd_vs_chembl_kd.pdf",
  p, width = 5, height = 12
)
```
